薰儿发现事情开始变得不对起来（薰儿发现事情开始变得不对起来（第22页）“抱歉，云宗主，我有不能说的理由，但等到能说的时候，我会一五一十将我的顾虑告诉你。”萧炎摇摇头，一脸认真地说道。看着那肃然的小脸，云韵也是有些无奈。她看得出来，眼前的小家伙的确是铁了心不愿意去云岚宗。但是这么好的天赋，她真的舍不得放过。“只是，若你不随我去云岚宗，即便是收你为徒，我也分身乏术，不好教导。”云韵有些纠结。片刻后，才试探着问道：“不如这样，我带着嫣然在这里留一段时间，一同教导你们，等你能够自己独立修炼了，我再带她回宗修行，离开之前，我会给你留下足够的修炼资源和修行的心得。”“如此甚好，萧炎拜见老师。”闻言，萧炎便俯身拜了下去。见到这一幕，云韵总算是松了一口气，这么好的弟子，别说加玛帝国，就是整个西北大陆，都未必能够找的出来一个，能让她就这么碰上，实在是运气好啊！“我看你气息，应该是刚晋级斗者吧，应该还没来得及测验斗气属性？来，我给你测测。”见萧炎起身，云韵伸手拉住他的手腕，从纳戒里取出一个水晶球，放在了萧炎手中。感受到手腕处的温润触感，萧炎略有些失神。之前离得远，倒是还好，现在靠近之后，一股成熟女子知性的气息，伴随着淡淡的芬芳香气扑面而来，饶是萧炎年龄小，没有太多生理上的冲动，心中却还是不可避免的泛起丝丝涟漪。“好浓郁的火属性反应！”看着那水晶球骤然间变得通红到耀眼的地步，云韵惊呼道。“不过云岚宗以风属性功法斗技为主，火属性倒的确是不太多。”云韵沉吟了一下，旋即从纳戒里掏出三根卷轴。“这是玄阶中级的火属性功法和斗技，你收哦，你没有纳戒是吧，我这里有一枚，你先凑合用。”说着，云韵从那白皙纤细的手指上，取下一枚淡青色的纳戒，连带着三根卷轴，一并塞入萧炎手中。“谢谢老师。”萧炎接过尚且带着余温和淡淡香气的纳戒，将其认主后，佩戴在了食指之上，顺手把卷轴收入其中。“既然谈好了，那我们便回去吧，别让他们等太久。”云韵微笑着点点头，主动拉起萧炎的小手，向着迎客大厅走去。好软。萧炎被拉住手，心头微微一动。女人的手，和男人的手，还真是不一样。当他被云韵带着进入迎客大厅的时候，便感受到一道有些扎人的目光，落在了自己身上。目光看了过去，发现薰儿目光微凝，停留在他被云韵拉着的小手上。嘶!这才几岁啊，就吃上醋了？“萧族长，萧炎已经答应做我的弟子了，我打算留在乌坦城一段时间，好教导他修炼，能给我准备一处清静一些的住处吗？”云韵带着温和的笑容，问道。“当然可以！我亲自去准备！”闻言，萧战顿时笑容满面，直接挥手示意三位长老替他散场，而他则是笑呵呵的带着云韵和纳兰嫣然，向着萧族宅院内最为僻静的一处庭院走去。

Xun'er found that things were starting to go wrong (Xun'er found that things were starting to go wrong (Page 22) "Sorry, Master Yun, I have reasons why I can't tell you, but when I can, I will tell you all my concerns." Xiao Yan shook his head and said seriously. Looking at the solemn little face, Yun Yun was also a little helpless. She could see that the little guy in front of her was indeed determined not to go to Yunlan Sect. But she really couldn't bear to let go of such a good talent. "But, if you don't follow me to the Yunlan Sect, even if I accept you as a disciple, I won't be able to teach you." Yun Yun was a little confused. After a moment, she asked tentatively: "How about this, I will take Yanran here for a while to teach you together. When you can practice independently, I will take her back to the sect to practice. Before I leave, I will leave you with enough training resources. Yuan He's practice experience. ""That's very good, Xiao Yan pays homage to the teacher." Hearing this, Xiao Yan leaned down and bowed down. Seeing this scene, Yun Yun finally breathed a sigh of relief. Not even the entire Northwest Continent might be able to find such a good disciple. It's really good luck for her to meet him like this! "I think you have just been promoted to a fighter, and you haven't had time to test the fighting spirit attribute yet? Come, let me test it for you." Seeing Xiao Yan stand up, Yun Yun stretched out her hand to hold his wrist, took out a crystal ball from the ring, and put it in Xiao Yan's hand. Feeling the warm touch on his wrist, Xiao Yan was slightly absent-minded. It was okay when he was far away, but now that he was close, a mature woman's intellectual breath came to his face, accompanied by a faint fragrance. Even though Xiao Yan was young and didn't have much physical impulse, he still felt uncomfortable in his heart. There were inevitable ripples. "What a strong fire attribute reaction!" Yun Yun exclaimed as she saw the crystal ball suddenly turn red to a dazzling level, "But Yunlan Sect mainly uses wind attribute fighting skills, and fire attribute. It's true that there isn't much sex." Yun Yun pondered for a moment, then took out three scrolls from the Najie. "These are the Xuan-level fire-attribute skills and fighting skills. Take them. You don't have the Najie, do you? I have one here. Let's make do with it first." As she said that, Yun Yun took off a light cyan ring from her fair and slender finger, along with three scrolls, and stuffed them into Xiao Yan's hand. "Thank you, teacher." Xiao Yan took the ring, which still had a warm and faint fragrance, and put it on his index finger, then put the scroll in it. "Now that we've agreed, let's go back and don't let them wait too long." Yun Yun nodded with a smile. He took Xiao Yan's hand and walked towards the reception hall. It was so soft. Xiao Yan's heart was slightly moved. When he was led into the reception hall by Yun Yun, he felt a bit of a piercing look on him. He looked over and found that Xun'er's eyes were fixed on his little hand held by Yun Yun. Hiss! How old are you now? Chief Xiao, Xiao Yan has agreed to be my disciple. I plan to stay in Wutan City for a while so that I can teach him how to practice. Can you prepare a quieter place for me?" Yun Yun asked with a gentle smile. "Of course! I will prepare it myself!" Upon hearing this, Xiao Zhan suddenly smiled and waved to the three elders to leave for him. He smiled and took Yun Yun and Nalan Yanran to the most remote place in the Xiao Clan's house.Walking to a quiet courtyard.
